title: ISLAND FLAGS
ask: Which country does this flag belong to?

questions.fact: Its Southern Cross stars are red, edged in white|⭐
The light blue stands for the Pacific Ocean|🌊
The gold bird is a bird of paradise|🐦
Its five white stars form the Southern Cross|✨
The yellow Y shows how the islands are laid out|🗺️
